mapper.select: SELECT mb.merchant_name AS 商家名称, COUNT(DISTINCT om.order_main_id) AS 订单量, COALESCE(SUM(om.pay_amount), 0) AS 营业额, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN om.order_status = 1 THEN om.order_main_id END) AS 待处理数量, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN om.order_status = 2 THEN om.order_main_id END) AS 待配送数量, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN om.order_status = 3 THEN om.order_main_id END) AS 配送中数量 FROM merchant_base mb LEFT JOIN order_takeout_detail otd ON mb.merchant_base_id = otd.merchant_id LEFT JOIN order_main om ON otd.order_main_id = om.order_main_id AND om.order_type = 1 -- 外卖订单 AND om.pay_status = 1 -- 已支付订单 WHERE mb.merchant_base_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY mb.merchant_base_id, mb.merchant_name
